title: Bug in Encryption key - Not Function as Administrator

judgment.rationale: Elevation alone does not identify a key-encryption defect. Current service-mode pairing intentionally has a different identity/storage contract, and an incompatible mode requires explicit re-pairing guidance. First identify the actual failing key operation; do not send a competing legacy-key-edit fix when #51377 already owns that specific path.
evidence: The report is for 0.102.2933 after auto-update and says only that the security key no longer functions in administrator mode.
There is no error text, service-mode setting, distinction between display/generate/edit/connect, or attached diagnostic report.

Source inspected at main 9227a8497750: src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/MouseWithoutBordersViewModel.cs: Service-mode pairing management requires elevation and uses a verified settings endpoint; ordinary administrator mode is not itself the service-mode setting. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/9227a8497750c257a0682b53c556d07f48ed8ff3/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/ViewModels/MouseWithoutBordersViewModel.cs

Source inspected at main 9227a8497750: src/modules/MouseWithoutBorders/App/Class/Setting.cs: The codec is created for the current identity; incompatible stored-mode state is distinguishable from ordinary empty configuration. https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/9227a8497750c257a0682b53c556d07f48ed8ff3/src/modules/MouseWithoutBorders/App/Class/Setting.cs

Read merged #51305's service-mode key/identity contract and open #51377's legacy UpdateKey persistence scope. Neither can be declared a fix for an unspecified administrator-mode symptom. No attachment/discussion is present.

actions.label: Identify the failing administrator-mode MWB key action

comment.body:
The administrator-mode detail on 0.102.2933 is useful, but it does not yet identify a failing key operation. Could you please:
- Say whether the failure is displaying, copying, generating, editing, or connecting with the key; quote the exact error (without the key), and say whether Use service is enabled. If it is specifically editing the key in the original MWB UI, please name that UI.
- After that one failing operation, comment /bugreport and attach the report. If Settings or the tray is unavailable, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys install directory. No need to publish the security key or reset the configuration first.
